data.name: Lorcan
data.gender_notes: Lorcan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Irish 'Lorcán', meaning 'little dark one'. In Irish mythology, Lorcan was a high king of Ireland associated with the sun and fire. The name Lorcan carries the meaning “Little dark one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Lorcan usually hope their child will grow to embody little dark one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner light and strength amidst darkness.
data.etymology: Lorcan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little dark one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lorcan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: לורקן
in_hebrew.meaning: לורקן משמעותו: אור קטן או אור של לורקן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לורקן הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו באירלנד, והוא נגזר מהשם הלועזי 'לורקן' שיכול להיות קשור למילה 'לור' שפירושה אור ו'קן' שיכול להיות שורש או קצה, כלומר אור קטן או קצה של אור. השם משמש לעתים קרובות בקהילות נוצריות ברחבי העולם.

in_greek.name: Λόρκαν
in_greek.meaning: Λόρκαν: σημαίνει μικρό φως ή ακτίνα φωτός
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Λόρκαν είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα ιρλανδικής προέλευσης, που πιθανότατα συνδέεται με την λέξη 'lor' που σημαίνει φως και το 'can' που σημαίνει μικρό ή γωνία. Το όνομα έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Ιρλανδία και σε άλλες χριστιανικές κοινότητες ως σύμβολο φωτός και ελπίδας.

in_latin.name: Lorcan
in_latin.meaning: Lorcan: significat parvum lumen vel oris luminis
in_latin.long_meaning: Lorcan est nomen christianum origine irlandica, derivatum ex vocibus 'lor' quod significat lumen et 'can' quod potest significare parvum vel terminum. Nomen hoc in usu est apud communitates christianas mundi, symbolum luminis et spei habens.

in_english.name: Lorcan
in_english.meaning: Lorcan means little fierce one or small light
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lorcan originates from Ireland and is of Christian tradition. It is believed to be derived from the Gaelic elements 'lor' meaning 'little fierce one' or 'luminous' and 'can' meaning 'small' or 'light'. The name Lorcan symbolizes a small but powerful light, often associated with spiritual guidance and inner strength. Historically, Lorcan has been used in Ireland and among Christian communities globally, reflecting its significance in Christian tradition and culture.
